description: 8-channel RS485 relay module, Modbus RTU. FC06 write to addresses 1-8 to control individual relays (0x0001=open,0x0002=close,0x0003=toggle,0x0004=latch,0x0005=momentary 1s,0x06AA=delay AA s). FC06 write to address 0 for broadcast (0x0007=open all,0x0008=close all). FC03 read addresses 1-8: 0x0001=open, 0x0000=close.
source: Omni Console device library (OmniCoreST), modbus-library/laskakit-8ch-rs485-relay.toml; Source: laskakit-8ch-rs485-relay-modbus-commands.pdf. Not verified against the manufacturer's documentation
notes: Converted automatically from the Omni Console device library (OmniCoreST).
Not verified against the manufacturer's documentation.
Corrections are welcome (CONTRIBUTING.md). Change x_status once this table has been checked against the manual.
| Protocol: Modbus RTU RS-485; default 9600 baud, 8N1 (selectable via M1/M2 pads)
| Slave ID: set via DIP switches A0-A5 (1-63); default varies by assembly
| FC06: Write Single Register — relay control
| FC03: Read Holding Registers — relay state
| Addresses 1-8 correspond to channels 1-8 (1-based PDU addressing).
| Address 0 is a broadcast-only write address (no FC03 read).
